senses.zh_definition: 若指英语专名 Blaire：人名，通常音译为“布莱尔”，是 Blair 的一种拼写形式；不能据此赋予小写 blaire 普通马来语词义。
senses.en_definition: If the English proper name is intended: a personal name, a variant spelling of Blair.
senses.ms_definition: Jika yang dimaksudkan ialah nama Inggeris Blaire: nama khas orang yang merupakan variasi ejaan Blair; bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 本义项仅说明已查到的英语人名用法。[来源](https://www.behindthename.com/name/blaire) 输入未提供上下文或 DBP 释义，无法确认目标词是否指该人名。以下搭配和例句为自拟人名用例，不代表已核实的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: For the English personal name, Blaire is a variant of Blair. Blair comes from a Scottish surname derived from Gaelic blàr, associated with a plain, field, or battlefield. This history concerns a name, not a Malay common word: it does not establish Malay meanings such as “field” or “battlefield” for blaire. [Blaire](https://www.behindthename.com/name/blaire), [Blair](https://www.behindthename.com/name/blair)
